{
  "analysis": "The training data reveals that German legal texts consistently use specific titles (Mag., Dr., Prof., etc.) and role indicators (Richter, Richterin, Beschwerdesache) to anchor person names. The main challenge is distinguishing between the judge's name and the party's name, as well as handling complex academic titles and suffixes (LL.M., Bakk. techn.).",
  "strategy": "Use context-aware regex patterns anchored by specific legal role keywords (Richter, Richterin, Beschwerdesache, vertreten durch) to capture names with their preceding titles and academic suffixes, ensuring high precision by requiring these structural anchors.",
  "note": "Every rule includes output_template and output_key. Patterns use capture groups to extract the full name span including titles.",
  "rules": [
    {
      "name": "Judge Name Extraction",
      "description": "Captures the name of the judge (Richter/Richterin) including titles and academic suffixes.",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?:durch\\s+(?:den\\s+)?(?:Richter|Richterin)\\s+)([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*(?:\\s+\\.\\s*[A-Z]+\\.?)*\\s*(?:LL\\.M\\.\\s*M\\.B\\.L\\.?)?)",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$1",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 10,
      "reasoning": "High priority rule to capture judges immediately following 'durch den Richter' or 'durch die Richterin', handling complex titles like 'Mag. Dr.' or 'Univ.-Prof.'."
    },
    {
      "name": "Party Name in Case Context",
      "description": "Captures the name of the party (Beschwerdeführer/Beschwerdegegner) following 'in der Beschwerdesache'.",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?:in\\s+der\\s+Beschwerdesache\\s+)([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*(?:,\\s*[A-Z][a-z]+\\.?)*\\s*(?:Bakk\\.\\s*techn\\.|Bakk\\.\\s*art\\.|Bakk\\.\\s*phil\\.\\s*MSc)?(?:,\\s*[A-Z][a-z]+\\.?)?)",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$1",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 9,
      "reasoning": "Targets the party name immediately after 'in der Beschwerdesache', capturing names with academic degrees like 'Bakk. techn.' or 'Bakk. art.'."
    },
    {
      "name": "Representative Name Extraction",
      "description": "Captures the name of a representative (Rechtsanwalt/Steuerberater) following 'vertreten durch'.",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?:vertreten\\s+durch\\s+(?:Rechtsanwälte|Steuerberater|Dr\\.?|Mag\\.?|Ing\\.?|Dipl\\.?\\-Ing\\.?)?\\s+)([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*)",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$1",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 8,
      "reasoning": "Captures names of legal representatives following 'vertreten durch', handling titles like 'Dr.', 'Mag.', 'Ing.'."
    },
    {
      "name": "Deceased Person Reference",
      "description": "Captures the name of a deceased person referenced in the text (e.g., 'verstorbenen').",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?:verstorbenen\\s+)([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*(?:HR)?(?:,\\s*[A-Z][a-z]+\\.?)?)",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$1",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 7,
      "reasoning": "Specifically targets deceased individuals mentioned with 'verstorbenen', capturing titles like 'HR' (Herr)."
    },
    {
      "name": "Anonymous/Initial Reference Correction",
      "description": "Captures names that might be partially anonymized or referred to with initials in specific contexts.",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?:Herr\\s+)([A-Z]\\.)",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$1",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 6,
      "reasoning": "Handles cases where only an initial is provided for a person (e.g., 'Herr A.') to ensure they are still tagged as a person entity."
    },
    {
      "name": "Complex Title Name Extraction",
      "description": "Captures names with very long or complex academic titles (e.g., 'Priv.-Doz.in', 'Hon.-Prof.in').",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?:[A-Z][a-z]+(?:\\-?[A-Z][a-z]+)*\\.?)(?:in)?(?:\\s+)([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*)",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$1",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 5,
      "reasoning": "General fallback for names preceded by complex academic titles not covered by specific rules, ensuring broad coverage."
    }
  ],
  "deleted_rules": []
}
